article.part: Contraste y dominio C2 — 대조와 C2 고급 운용
article.chapter: Norma, estilo y elección avanzada C2 — 규범·문체·C2 고급 선택

claims.summary: Kim (2020) analyzed three speeches by former South Korean president Park Geun-hye, their human translations, and Google Translate output in Spanish, studying interference in Korean-Spanish machine translation.

The study reports interference-related mistranslations associated mainly with incorrect parsing of source syntax, lack of context, grammatical and conventional factors; it also reports unnatural target-sentence organization from excessive copying of source structure and failure to account for discourse and genre.

The review checklist follows the study’s reported error sources by checking source syntax, context, target organization and genre; the entry explicitly limits its claims to the studied Korean-to-Spanish machine translation of presidential speeches.
